rationale: Reviewed 2026-11-01 against the pinned vendor images: gosu only reads local user/group files, changes process credentials, and execs the requested command; it does not establish TLS connections or use certificate validation/session resumption. CVE-2025-68121 crypto/tls paths are unreachable. Current pinned vendor images still bundle Go v1.24.6 gosu; retain this binary-and-package-scoped exception pending a vendor rebuild.
